passages.text: Pay scale 2027. This scale applies to every employee from 1 January 2027. Level 1 starts at 32,000 EUR a year and ends at 38,000 EUR. Level 2 starts at 41,000 EUR and ends at 49,000 EUR.
Level 3 starts at 52,000 EUR and ends at 63,000 EUR. Level 4 starts at 66,000 EUR and ends at 80,000 EUR. Team leads get a yearly allowance of 3,000 EUR on top of their level.
Raises. HR reviews every salary in April. A raise moves an employee at most two steps inside the level. A move to the next level needs the approval of the HR director.
